name: OMNIconnect
summary: Wireless Internet service provider (OMNIconnect Pty Ltd, ACN 079 282 376, ABN 36 079 282 376; VIC South Melbourne, still registered). omni.net.au (1999-2004): 'OMNIconnect aim to become a leading supplier of Wireless Internet Services in Australia'; wireless broadband 256Kbps-2Mbps, OMNInet MAN metropolitan wireless networking, wholesale to carriers up to 155Mbps. Held the 1997 allocation OMNI 'ISP Core Network' (203.143.64.0/19).

events.details: OMNIconnect Pty Ltd, ACN 079 282 376 (reg ~1997). 1997 allocation: OMNI 'ISP Core Network' (203.143.64.0/19). omni.net.au captured 25 Jan 1999: wireless telecommunications carrier (ACA list), OMNInet MAN metropolitan wireless networking (256K Melbourne CBD), 10Mb LAN microwave, wireless bridges; Mount Eliza VIC. By 2002 'Omniconnect Internet' offered wireless broadband 256Kbps-2Mbps and wholesale carrier/ISP services up to 155Mbps.
